It consumes Harness contracts rather than creating separate provider runtimes, state stores, or "},{"id":"p15s3","text":"consumes Harness contracts rather than creating separate provider runtimes, state stores, or policy."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"`Harness plugin → standard capability → dshline presentation adapter → native terminal UI`"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Harness owns capabilities, state, runtime, persistence, and policy. dshline owns terminal presentati"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"ness owns capabilities, state, runtime, persistence, and policy. dshline owns terminal presentation."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### Generic capability integration"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"dshline integrates through standard Harness capabilities instead of provider-specific code. Work con"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"sumes `ctx.jobs` and `ctx.subagents`; Sessions uses `ctx.sessionQuery`; `/connect` uses Harness's mo"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"del, settings, credentials, and authorization services; `/plugins` reads and switches the running ag"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"ent's composition through `ctx.agentPresets`; `/profiles` reads the profile roster through Harness's"},{"id":"p19s5","text":" own home-path service and forwards every change to `dsh plugin`. New providers can therefore flow t"},{"id":"p19s6","text":"hrough existing interfaces without requiring a dedicated dshline implementation. A real Codex provid"},{"id":"p19s7","text":"er has already passed this boundary through generic `ctx.subagents` and `ctx.jobs` presentation, wit"},{"id":"p19s8","text":"h no provider-specific dshline production code; see Provider acceptance."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"It ships no provider list and no login protocol: `/connect` offers whatever the mounted adapters dec"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"lare configurable and runs whatever flows Harness has registered, so the same providers are reachabl"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"e from the terminal and from the official web Models page, over one settings document and one creden"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"terminal and from the official web Models page, over one settings document and one credential store."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"See Architecture for the capability model and current adapter boundaries."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"### Native terminal by design"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Finished output is committed to real terminal scrollback and never rewritten. Normal scrolling, sele"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"ction, and copying keep working while dshline redraws only a bounded live region. - `/image <path>` — stage a PNG, JPEG, WebP, or GIF as a real H"},{"id":"p27s5","text":"arness image for the next prompt; `@path` remains a textual reference
